about: Rules for B1's closure test (scripts/build-bundle.mjs --stage closure; docs/DESIGN.md#engine-and-data). Each class, and each .sty in a package's own tex/latex folder, loads alone in a minimal document. 'setup' gives a file the preamble it needs first, when it works only on top of another package. 'expected' lists failures that are right for this set, with the reason: helpers and documentation tools that need a package only extra-data holds, font options whose fonts are in extra-data, and LuaTeX branches. The report says which missing files extra-data holds, and names a listed file that loads now, so the list stays honest. Any other failure stops the build.

tex/latex/babelbib/babelbib.sty.reason: babelbib works on top of babel with a main language; with none, babel stops at \begin{document}
